cards.en:
Why it matters: Think of a school library with only paper cards. To know if a book is in, someone must walk to the shelf. An information system fixes this: a computer keeps the record up to date for everyone.

How it works:

An information system = a set of parts (data, hardware, software, process, personnel) that work together to collect, store, process and output information.

  • Book borrowed → status changes to "on loan" at once.
  • Book returned → status changes to "available".
  • Anyone can check the status without searching shelves.

Exam wording:

  • It is used to automate processes.
  • It reduces human errors.
  • It improves efficiency.
  • Always link each point to the scenario in the question.
cards.zh:
先理解: 想像一个只用纸卡的图书馆：要知道书在不在，就要走去书架找。information system（资讯系统）让电脑实时更新记录，人人都能马上查到。

重点:

资讯系统 = 多个部分（data、hardware、software、process、personnel）一起合作，去收集、储存、处理和输出资讯。

  • 借书 → 状态立即变为“借出”。
  • 还书 → 状态变回“可借”。
  • 不用去书架找就能查到。

考试写法:

  • automate processes（自动化流程）
  • reduce human errors（减少人为错误）
  • improve efficiency（提高效率）
  • 每一点都要配合题目情境说明。

ex.q: A supermarket installs a checkout system with barcode scanners. Give two benefits of this information system.
ex.a:
1. Find what changes: prices no longer typed by hand.
  2. Benefit 1: it reduces human errors, because the price is read from the barcode, not typed.
  3. Benefit 2: it improves efficiency, because each item is scanned in under a second, so queues are shorter.
ex.az:
1. 找出改变：价钱不用人手输入。
  2. 好处一：reduces human errors，价钱由条码读取。
  3. 好处二：improves efficiency，每件货品一秒扫完，排队更短。

ex.q: A library system updates book status. How does it automate a process?
ex.a:
1. Before: staff wrote the loan on a card and filed it.
  2. After: scanning the book and the member card updates the record automatically.
  3. So the recording step is automated: no manual filing.
ex.az:
1. 以前：职员把借书资料写在卡上存档。
  2. 现在：扫描书和借书证就自动更新。
  3. 记录步骤自动化，不用人手存档。

ex.q: A student answers: "An information system is a computer." Is this correct?
ex.a:
1. Wrong: a computer is only hardware, one of five parts.
  2. An information system also needs data, software, process and personnel.
  3. Correct answer: "A system of data, hardware, software, process and personnel working together to collect, store, process and output information."
ex.az:
1. 错：电脑只是 hardware，五个组成部分之一。
  2. 资讯系统还需要 data、software、process、personnel。
  3. 正确写法：由五个部分合作去收集、储存、处理和输出资讯的系统。

cards.t: Five components of an information system
cards.tz: 资讯系统的五个组成部分
cards.en:
Why it matters: A restaurant needs ingredients, a kitchen, recipes, cooking steps and chefs. Remove one and no food comes out. An information system is the same with its five components.

How it works:

ComponentMeaningRestaurant analogy
Datafacts stored and used by programsingredients
Hardwarephysical deviceskitchen equipment
Softwareprograms that runrecipes (instructions)
Processorder of steps for handling datacooking order
Personnelpeople who build, run, support itchefs
Memory aid: D-H-S-P-P.

Exam wording:

  • The five components are data, hardware, software, process and personnel.
  • If one is missing, the system cannot work properly.
cards.zh:
先理解: 餐厅要有食材、厨房、食谱、烹调次序和厨师，缺一个就做不出菜。资讯系统也一样有五个组成部分。

重点:

部分意思餐厅比喻
Data储存并供程式使用的事实食材
Hardware实体装置厨具
Software运行的程式食谱
Process处理数据的步骤次序烹调次序
Personnel建立、操作、支援系统的人厨师
口诀：D-H-S-P-P。

考试写法:

  • 五个部分：data, hardware, software, process and personnel。
  • 缺少其中一个，系统就无法正常运作。

ex.q: Classify for a school attendance system: (i) student card reader (ii) attendance records (iii) the clerk (iv) attendance app.
ex.a:
1. Card reader is a physical device → hardware.
  2. Attendance records are stored facts → data.
  3. The clerk is a person → personnel.
  4. The app is a program → software.
ex.az:
1. 读卡器是实体装置 → hardware。
  2. 出席纪录是数据 → data。
  3. 文员是人 → personnel。
  4. 应用程式是程式 → software。

ex.q: Give the process component of the attendance system.
ex.a:
1. Process = the order of steps.
  2. Step 1: student taps card. Step 2: system records time. Step 3: at 8:15 a.m. absentees are listed. Step 4: clerk calls parents.
  3. This order is the process.
ex.az:
1. Process 是步骤的次序。
  2. 拍卡 → 记录时间 → 8:15 列出缺席 → 文员致电家长。
  3. 这个次序就是 process。

ex.q: MC option: "Personnel: word processor". Correct?
ex.a:
1. A word processor is a program, so it is software.
  2. Personnel must be people, e.g. a programmer.
  3. So the match is wrong.
ex.az:
1. 文书处理软件是程式 → software。
  2. Personnel 一定是人，例如 programmer。
  3. 所以配对错误。

frames.en: The clerk follows the process: a fixed order of steps.
frames.zh: 文员按 process（步骤次序）做事。

frames.en: The software runs on hardware (computer, card reader).
frames.zh: 软件在 hardware 上运行。

frames.en: The hardware stores and reads data → output information.
frames.zh: 硬件储存和读取 data，输出资讯。

cards.en:
Why it matters: Data is the "raw material" of the system. Without it, the best computer has nothing to work on.

How it works:

Data is stored in storage devices and used by programs for input or output. It can be text, images, audio or video.

  • Hospital: a patient's medical history.
  • Hong Kong Observatory: weather data such as satellite images.

Note: "data" was the plural of "datum"; today we usually say "data is".

Exam wording:

  • Data is stored in storage devices and used by programs for input/output.
  • Forms: text, image, audio, video.
cards.zh:
先理解: 数据是系统的“原材料”，没有数据，再好的电脑也没事可做。

重点:

Data 储存在储存装置中，由程式用作输入或输出，形式有 text、image、audio、video。

  • 医院：病人的病历。
  • 天文台：卫星云图等天气数据。

考试写法:

  • stored in storage devices and used by programs for input/output
  • 形式：text, image, audio, video。

ex.q: Give two examples of data in a school system and their form.
ex.a:
1. Student names → text.
  2. Student ID photos → image.
ex.az:
1. 学生姓名 → text。
  2. 学生证相片 → image。

ex.q: In an online music app, name the data and its form.
ex.a:
1. Songs → audio.
  2. Song titles and artists → text.
  3. Album covers → image.
ex.az:
1. 歌曲 → audio。
  2. 歌名、歌手 → text。
  3. 封面 → image。

ex.q: A student says: "The hard disk is the data component." Correct?
ex.a:
1. Wrong: the hard disk is a physical device → hardware.
  2. Data is what is stored on the hard disk, e.g. the records.
ex.az:
1. 错：硬盘是实体装置 → hardware。
  2. 数据是储存在硬盘里的内容，例如纪录。

cards.en:
Why it matters: Hardware is everything you can touch. Each device has a job, like body parts: eyes take in (input), brain thinks (processing), mouth speaks (output).

How it works:

FunctionHardware
ProcessingCPU
Connect system unitsMotherboard
Network communicationRouter, switch, Bluetooth USB dongle
InputKeyboard, microphone, barcode scanner
OutputMonitor, speaker, information panel

Exam wording:

  • Hardware refers to the physical devices used in an information system.
  • State the device and its function, e.g. "barcode scanner – input".
cards.zh:
先理解: 硬件就是摸得到的东西。每件装置有自己的工作，就像身体：眼睛输入、大脑处理、嘴巴输出。

重点:

功能硬件
处理CPU
连接系统单元Motherboard
网络通讯Router、switch、蓝牙 USB dongle
输入键盘、咪高峰、barcode scanner
输出显示器、喇叭、资讯板

考试写法:

  • Hardware refers to the physical devices used in an information system。
  • 答题写出装置和功能。

ex.q: A fast-food shop uses a touch screen kiosk, a receipt printer and a kitchen display. Give each function.
ex.a:
1. Touch screen kiosk: customer taps orders → input (also shows the menu → output).
  2. Receipt printer → output.
  3. Kitchen display → output.
ex.az:
1. 触控点餐机：输入（也显示菜单，输出）。
  2. 收据打印机：输出。
  3. 厨房显示屏：输出。

ex.q: Which hardware connects the CPU, memory and other units?
ex.a:
1. Units must be joined by circuits.
  2. That board is the motherboard.
ex.az:
1. 连接各单元的电路板。
  2. 答案：motherboard。

ex.q: A student classifies a router as "processing". Fix it.
ex.a:
1. Processing is done by the CPU.
  2. A router passes data between networks → network communication.
ex.az:
1. 处理由 CPU 负责。
  2. Router 负责网络通讯。

cards.tz: 软件：系统软件与应用软件
cards.en:
Why it matters: Hardware is the body; software is the instructions. Some software looks after the computer itself (system software). Other software helps you do a task (application software).

How it works:

TypeSub-typeExamples
System softwareOperating systemWindows, macOS, Android, iOS
Utility programTask Manager, anti-virus
Driverprinter driver, sound card driver
Application softwareWord processor, DBMS, web browser

Exam wording:

  • Software refers to the programs running in an information system.
  • System software runs and maintains the computer; application software lets users do specific tasks.
cards.zh:
先理解: 硬件是身体，软件是指令。有些软件照顾电脑本身（system software），有些帮你完成工作（application software）。

重点:

类别子类例子
System softwareOperating systemWindows、macOS、Android、iOS
Utility工作管理员、防毒软件
Driver打印机驱动程式
Application software文书处理、DBMS、浏览器

考试写法:

  • system software 运行和维护电脑；application software 让用户完成特定工作。

ex.q: Classify: iOS, a printer driver, Google Chrome, anti-virus.
ex.a:
1. iOS → system software (OS).
  2. Printer driver → system software (driver).
  3. Chrome → application software.
  4. Anti-virus → system software (utility).
ex.az:
1. iOS → OS。
  2. 打印机驱动 → driver。
  3. Chrome → 应用软件。
  4. 防毒 → utility。

ex.q: A new printer does not print. Which software is probably missing?
ex.a:
1. The OS needs a program to talk to the printer.
  2. That is the printer driver (system software).
ex.az:
1. 作业系统需要程式与打印机沟通。
  2. 即 printer driver。

ex.q: A student writes: "Anti-virus is application software because users install it." Correct?
ex.a:
1. Wrong: installing it yourself does not make it application software.
  2. Anti-virus maintains/protects the computer → utility program → system software.
ex.az:
1. 错：自己安装不代表是应用软件。
  2. 防毒保护电脑 → utility → system software。

cards.en:
Why it matters: A recipe tells you the order: you cannot fry an egg before cracking it. In a system, process is that order of steps for data.

How it works:

Process = the series of steps that decides the order in which data is processed.

Hospital example:
  1. Doctor examines patient, writes report and prescription.
  2. Nurse updates the medical record.
  3. Pharmacist gives medicine and updates stock.
  4. System makes a receipt.
  5. System makes a monthly operating statement.

Exam wording:

  • Process determines the order in which data is processed.
  • It ensures data achieves the purpose precisely.
cards.zh:
先理解: 食谱告诉你次序：未打蛋就不能煎蛋。系统里的 process 就是处理数据的步骤次序。

重点:

Process = 一系列步骤，决定数据处理的次序。

医院例子：
  1. 医生诊症、写报告和处方。
  2. 护士更新病历。
  3. 药剂师配药并更新存货。
  4. 系统产生收据。
  5. 月底产生营运报表。

考试写法:

  • determines the order in which data is processed

ex.q: Put in order for an online shop: (A) ship goods (B) customer pays (C) customer adds to cart (D) stock updated.
ex.a:
1. You must choose before paying: C first.
  2. Then B (pay).
  3. Then D (stock reduced after payment).
  4. Then A (ship).
  5. Order: C → B → D → A.
ex.az:
1. 先加入购物车 C。
  2. 再付款 B。
  3. 然后更新存货 D。
  4. 最后出货 A。

ex.q: Why must the pharmacist step come after the doctor step?
ex.a:
1. The pharmacist needs the prescription as input.
  2. The prescription is created by the doctor step.
  3. So the order matters.
ex.az:
1. 药剂师需要处方作输入。
  2. 处方由医生产生。

ex.q: A student says: "Process means the CPU." Correct?
ex.a:
1. Wrong: the CPU does processing and is hardware.
  2. The process component is the order of steps people and software follow.
ex.az:
1. 错：CPU 是 hardware。
  2. Process 组成部分是步骤次序。

cards.en:
Why it matters: Building a system is like building a house: someone plans it, someone builds it, someone fixes things later. Each IT job has one main duty.

How it works:

RoleMain duty (exam wording)
Computer engineerdesign, build and integrate hardware, software and network
Systems analystdesign a system for user needs; analyse time, cost and feasibility
Programmerdevelop the system according to the design
Technical supportassist end users
Network managermonitor network communication
Database administratordesign and manage databases

End users just use the system (e.g. nurses).

Exam wording:

  • Match each role to its duty using the bold phrases.
cards.zh:
先理解: 建系统就像建屋：有人规划、有人施工、有人维修。每个 IT 职位有一个主要职责。

重点:

职位职责
Computer engineer设计、建造及整合硬件、软件和网络
Systems analyst按用户需要设计系统，分析时间、成本、可行性
Programmer按设计开发系统
Technical support协助用户
Network manager监察网络通讯
DBA设计及管理数据库

考试写法:

  • 用表中粗体英文配对职位与职责。

ex.q: Teachers cannot log in to the school system. Who helps?
ex.a: 1. Helping users → technical support.
ex.az: 1. 协助用户 → technical support。

ex.q: A school wants a new library system and asks if it can be done within $200,000. Who studies this?
ex.a: 1. Cost and feasibility analysis → systems analyst.
ex.az: 1. 分析成本和可行性 → systems analyst。

ex.q: A student writes: "The programmer decides what the system should do."
ex.a:
1. Wrong: the systems analyst designs the system from user needs.
  2. The programmer develops it according to the design.
ex.az:
1. 错：设计由 systems analyst 负责。
  2. Programmer 按设计编写程式。

cards.en:
Why it matters: The numbers "81, 62, 35" mean nothing alone. Put them in a table with the heading "Exam score" and they tell you who passed. That is data → information.

How it works:

  • Data: a collection of unorganised facts which usually has no meaning on its own.
  • Information: data that is processed and put into context; it is relevant to users and helps decision making.
  • The same thing can be information for one person and data for the next task.

Exam wording:

  • Data is unorganised facts with no meaning on its own.
  • Information is processed data put into context, useful for decision making.
cards.zh:
先理解: “81, 62, 35” 单独看没有意义。放进有“考试分数”标题的表，就看得出谁合格。这就是 data → information。

重点:

  • Data：未整理的事实，本身通常没有意义。
  • Information：经处理、放进情境的数据，对用户有用，帮助作决定。
  • 同一样东西对一人是资讯，对下一个工作可以是数据。

考试写法:

  • Data: unorganised facts with no meaning on its own。
  • Information: processed data put into context, useful for decision making。

ex.q: Is each data or information? (i) 27, 31, 29 (ii) "Average temperature this week: 29°C, hotter than last week".
ex.a:
1. (i) bare numbers, no context → data.
  2. (ii) processed (average), has context and helps decide (bring water) → information.
ex.az:
1. (i) 没有情境 → data。
  2. (ii) 经处理、有情境 → information。

ex.q: A teacher's class average is later used by the principal to compare all classes. Explain.
ex.a:
1. To the teacher, the average is information.
  2. For the principal's comparison it is the input data of a new process.
  3. So information can become data for the next task.
ex.az:
1. 对老师是 information。
  2. 对校长比较时是 data。

ex.q: A student writes: "Data is wrong information."
ex.a:
1. Wrong: data is not false, just unorganised and without context.
  2. Write: "Data is a collection of unorganised facts which usually has no meaning on its own."
ex.az: 1. 错：数据不是错误资讯，只是未整理、没有情境。

cards.en:
Why it matters: A juicer: fruit goes in (input), the machine blends (process), juice comes out (output). A computer turns data into information in the same three steps.

How it works:

  1. Input: data is entered (keyboard, scanner, sensor).
  2. Process: the computer calculates, sorts, groups.
  3. Output: meaningful information comes out (screen, printer, chart).

Example: student weights → grouped and counted → histogram.

Exam wording:

  • Name each stage concretely: what data, which device / what calculation / what result and form.
cards.zh:
先理解: 榨汁机：水果放进去（输入）、搅拌（处理）、果汁出来（输出）。电脑把数据变成资讯也是这三步。

重点:

  1. Input：输入数据（键盘、扫描器、感应器）。
  2. Process：计算、排序、分组。
  3. Output：输出有意义的资讯（屏幕、打印、图表）。

考试写法:

  • 答题要具体写出：输入什么数据和装置、做什么处理、输出什么结果和形式。

ex.q: Describe the IPO cycle of an online class average calculator for marks 72, 65, 88.
ex.a:
1. Input: teacher types 72, 65, 88 with a keyboard.
  2. Process: total = 72+65+88 = 225; average = 225 ÷ 3 = 75.
  3. Output: "Average = 75.0" shown on the monitor.

ex.q: A smart thermostat: describe IPO.
ex.a:
1. Input: temperature sensor reads 28°C.
  2. Process: compare with target 25°C → too hot.
  3. Output: turn on air-conditioner; show "Cooling".
ex.az:
1. 输入：感应器 28°C。
  2. 处理：与 25°C 比较。
  3. 输出：开冷气，显示 Cooling。

ex.q: A student writes "Output: the printer." Full marks?
ex.a:
1. Not enough: the printer is only the device.
  2. State the information: "a printed report card showing each student's average".
ex.az:
1. 不够：打印机只是装置。
  2. 要写出输出的资讯内容。

code.src:
marks = [72, 65, 88]
total = sum(marks)
avg = total / len(marks)
print("Average =", round(avg, 1))

notes.t: Input: store the raw marks (data) in a list.
notes.tz: 输入：把原始分数存入列表。

notes.t: Process: divide by the number of marks (3).
Output: show the information, rounded to 1 d.p.
notes.tz: 输出：显示资讯，取 1 位小数。

cards.en:
Why it matters: Computers only store 0s and 1s. To store the letter "A", we need an agreed code table, like a secret code everyone shares. That table is a character encoding system.

How it works:

Text includes numbers, letters and symbols. It is stored using a character encoding system. Different languages may use different systems.

EncodingLanguage
ASCIIEnglish
Big5Traditional Chinese
GB (Guobiao)Simplified Chinese
Unicodealmost all languages

Exam wording:

  • Text is represented by a character encoding system.
  • Sender and receiver must use the same encoding, or text shows as garbled characters.
cards.zh:
先理解: 电脑只储存 0 和 1。要储存“A”，就要一个大家同意的对照表，这就是 character encoding system（字符编码）。

重点:

文本包括数字、字母、符号，用 character encoding 储存。不同语言可用不同编码。

编码语言
ASCII英文
Big5繁体中文
GB简体中文
Unicode几乎所有语言

考试写法:

  • 发送方和接收方要用相同编码，否则出现乱码。

ex.q: In ASCII, "A" = 65. What is "C"?
ex.a:
1. Letters are in order: A=65, B=66.
  2. C = 67.

ex.q: Which encoding should a webpage with English, Chinese and Japanese use?
ex.a:
1. ASCII has no Chinese. Big5 has no Japanese kana.
  2. Unicode covers all of them.
ex.az:
1. ASCII 没中文，Big5 没日文假名。
  2. 用 Unicode。

ex.q: A Big5 file opened as GB shows nonsense. A student says "the file is corrupted".
ex.a:
1. Not necessarily: the bytes are fine.
  2. The wrong encoding is used to read them.
  3. Fix: open with Big5 (or convert to Unicode).
ex.az:
1. 不一定损坏。
  2. 是用错编码读取。
  3. 改用 Big5 开启。

cards.en:
Why it matters: A handwritten note has just words. A poster has words plus big fonts and colours. Plain text is the note; formatted text is the poster.

How it works:

Plain textFormatted text
Storescharacters onlycharacters + formatting data (font type, size, colour, line spacing, alignment)
File sizesmallerlarger
Example.txt.docx, .rtf

Exam wording:

  • Plain text stores characters only.
  • Formatted text stores characters and their formatting data; its file size is larger.
cards.zh:
先理解: 手写便条只有字；海报有字还有大字体、颜色。便条是纯文本，海报是格式化文本。

重点:

Plain textFormatted text
储存只有字符字符 + 格式数据（字体、大小、颜色、行距、对齐）
档案大小较小较大
例子.txt.docx

考试写法:

  • Plain text stores characters only；formatted text stores characters and formatting data，档案较大。

ex.q: "Hello" saved as .txt and .docx. Which is bigger and why?
ex.a:
1. .docx stores formatting data as well.
  2. So .docx is bigger.
ex.az: 1. .docx 另外储存格式数据，所以较大。

ex.q: A program reads settings from a config file. Plain or formatted text? Why?
ex.a:
1. The program only needs characters.
  2. Plain text: smaller and readable by any program.
ex.az: 1. 程式只需字符，用 plain text。

ex.q: MC: "Plain text can store font size." True?
ex.a:
1. False: plain text stores characters only.
  2. Font size is formatting data → formatted text.
ex.az: 1. 错：plain text 只存字符。

cards.en:
Why it matters: A bitmap is like a mosaic of tiny tiles: zoom in and you see the squares. A vector image is like drawing instructions ("circle, radius 5"): redraw at any size and it stays sharp.

How it works:

BitmapVector
Stored aspixels, each with a binary colour valuemathematical formulae (points, lines, curves)
Scaling upbecomes blurry/jaggedno rough edges, not blurry
File sizeusually largertends to be smaller
Good forreal photoslogos, icons, diagrams

Exam wording:

  • Bitmap images are stored as pixels, each with a binary number for its colour.
  • Vector images are stored as mathematical formulae; they do not become blurry when scaled.
cards.zh:
先理解: 位图像马赛克：放大会见到方格。矢量图像画图指令（“半径 5 的圆”）：任何大小重画都清晰。

重点:

BitmapVector
储存方式像素，每个有颜色二进制值数学公式
放大模糊/锯齿不会模糊
档案较大较小
适合相片标志、图示

考试写法:

  • stored as pixels / stored as mathematical formulae，矢量图 not blurry when scaled。

ex.q: A school logo must be printed on a pen and a 3 m banner. Which type?
ex.a:
1. Needs many sizes.
  2. Vector: scales with no blur.
ex.az: 1. 要多种尺寸 → vector。

ex.q: Which type does a phone camera produce?
ex.a:
1. A camera records light per point.
  2. → bitmap (pixels).
ex.az: 1. 相机逐点记录 → bitmap。

ex.q: A student enlarges a photo and says "it's blurry because the file is compressed".
ex.a:
1. Not the main reason: a bitmap has a fixed number of pixels.
  2. Enlarging stretches each pixel → blurry/jagged.
ex.az: 1. 主要原因：位图像素数量固定，放大就拉阔像素。

cards.en:
Why it matters: Sound is a smooth wave in the air (analog). A computer can only keep numbers (digital). So we must convert on the way in and back on the way out.

How it works:

Path of sound:

  1. Sound (analog) → microphone → electric signal (analog)
  2. Sound card converts to binary numbers (digital) → stored / edited
  3. Sound card converts back → speaker → sound (analog)

MIDI stores musical note data instead of a recording: easier to edit, smaller.

Exam wording:

  • Digital audio is data that can be converted to sounds (analog signals).
  • Stored digitally so it can be edited and reproduced.
cards.zh:
先理解: 声音是空气中连续的波（模拟），电脑只能存数字（数码），所以输入和输出时都要转换。

重点:

  1. 声音（模拟）→ 咪高峰 → 电讯号（模拟）
  2. 声卡转成二进制（数码）→ 储存/编辑
  3. 声卡转回 → 喇叭 → 声音（模拟）

MIDI 储存音符数据，较易编辑、较小。

考试写法:

  • Digital audio is data that can be converted to sounds；数码储存方便 edited and reproduced。

ex.q: Analog or digital: (i) your voice (ii) signal from the microphone (iii) the .mp3 file.
ex.a:
1. (i) analog.
  2. (ii) analog (electric signal).
  3. (iii) digital.
ex.az:
1. (i) 模拟。
  2. (ii) 模拟。
  3. (iii) 数码。

ex.q: Which device changes the analog signal to binary?
ex.a: 1. The sound card.
ex.az: 1. 声卡。

ex.q: A student says "the microphone converts sound to digital data."
ex.a:
1. Wrong: the microphone gives an analog electric signal.
  2. The sound card does the analog→digital conversion.
ex.az: 1. 错：咪高峰输出模拟电讯号，声卡才转数码。

demo.title: From voice to file and back

frames.en: Changed to an analog electric signal.
Saved as a digital file, can be edited.
Sound card converts back; speaker plays sound.

cards.en:
Why it matters: A flip book: many pictures shown fast look like movement. Add sound and you have a video.

How it works:

  • Video = images + audio. Showing many images quickly makes a moving image.
  • Videos have large file sizes, so they are usually compressed (to save space, not to improve quality).
  • Made with digital cameras or video editing software.

Exam wording:

  • Videos are combinations of images and audios.
  • Usually stored as compressed files because of their large size.
cards.zh:
先理解: 翻页书：很多图片快速翻动就像在动，加上声音就是影片。

重点:

  • Video = images + audio，快速显示图片形成动态影像。
  • 档案大，所以通常压缩（为减少大小，不是提升质素）。
  • 用数码相机或影片编辑软件制作。

考试写法:

  • Videos are combinations of images and audios；通常 stored as compressed files。

ex.q: Why is a 1-minute video bigger than a photo?
ex.a:
1. 1 minute at 30 frames/s = 60 × 30 = 1800 images.
  2. Plus audio.
  3. So much more data.

ex.q: Name two media types inside a video.
ex.a:
1. Images (frames).
  2. Audio.
ex.az: 1. 图像、声音。

ex.q: A student says "videos are compressed to make them clearer".
ex.a:
1. Wrong: compression reduces file size.
  2. Lossy compression may even lower quality.
ex.az: 1. 错：压缩是为减少档案大小，有损压缩甚至降低质素。

cards.en:
Why it matters: Making a class survey report is a journey: hand out forms, sort them, save them, count, look for patterns, send to the teacher, then show slides. Those are the seven stages.

How it works:

  1. Collection: Gather raw data (survey, sensor).
  2. Organisation: Sort, validate, convert type.
  3. Storage: Save on hard disk / cloud.
  4. Processing: Edit, update, calculate.
  5. Analysis: Find trends with charts/statistics.
  6. Transmission: Send through a network.
  7. Presentation: Output as chart, slides, report.

Memory aid: C-O-S-P-A-T-P. Presented information can become new data, so it can repeat.

Exam wording:

  • Information processing converts raw data into meaningful information.
  • Stages: data collection, organisation, storage, processing, analysis, transmission, presentation.
cards.zh:
先理解: 做一份班级问卷报告：派问卷、整理、储存、统计、找规律、传给老师、做简报。这就是七个阶段。

重点:

  1. Collection（收集）：收集原始数据（问卷、感应器）。
  2. Organisation（组织）：排列、检验、转换类型。
  3. Storage（储存）：存到硬盘/云端。
  4. Processing（处理）：编辑、更新、计算。
  5. Analysis（分析）：用图表统计找趋势。
  6. Transmission（传送）：经网络传送。
  7. Presentation（展示）：以图表、简报输出。

口诀：C-O-S-P-A-T-P。

考试写法:

  • Information processing converts raw data into meaningful information.

ex.q: A school canteen survey. Name the stage: (i) students fill an online form (ii) answers sorted by class (iii) count favourite dishes (iv) bar chart shown at assembly.
ex.a:
1. (i) collection
  2. (ii) organisation
  3. (iii) processing
  4. (iv) presentation
ex.az:
1. (i) 收集
  2. (ii) 组织
  3. (iii) 处理
  4. (iv) 展示

ex.q: The survey file is emailed to the principal. Which stage?
ex.a: 1. Sending between devices → transmission.
ex.az: 1. 传送 → transmission。

ex.q: A student lists "input, process, output" as the stages of information processing.
ex.a:
1. That is the IPO cycle, not the seven stages.
  2. The question wants the seven: collection, organisation, storage, processing, analysis, transmission, presentation.
ex.az: 1. 那是 IPO cycle，题目要求七个阶段。

frames.zh: 收集原始数据（问卷、感应器）。

cards.t: Data collection: methods, scope, data type
cards.tz: 数据收集：方法、范围、数据类型
cards.en:
Why it matters: Counting 30 students? Just count by hand. Counting 50,000 shoppers? You need sensors. The right method depends on size and on the kind of data.

How it works:

Methods: observation, experiments, interviews, surveys. Input devices (microphones, sensors, cameras) make it faster and more precise.

ConsiderExample
ScopeClassroom → count manually; shopping mall → sensors at entrances
Data typeNoise → sound level meter; car speed → speed enforcement camera

Exam wording:

  • Consider the scope and the data type when choosing a collection method.
  • Input devices enhance efficiency and precision.
cards.zh:
先理解: 数 30 个学生用手数就可以；数 5 万名商场顾客就要感应器。方法取决于规模和数据类型。

重点:

方法：观察、实验、访问、问卷。输入装置令收集更快更准。

考虑例子
Scope课室人工数；商场入口装感应器
Data type噪音用 sound level meter；车速用 speed camera

考试写法:

  • 考虑 scope 和 data type；输入装置 enhance efficiency and precision。

ex.q: Suggest a method to collect the opinions of 1,200 students about the school uniform.
ex.a:
1. Large scope, opinions are text/choices.
  2. Use an online survey: fast, auto-collected.
ex.az: 1. 人数多 → 网上问卷。

ex.q: How to collect hourly air temperature on a hill for a month?
ex.a:
1. People cannot stay there.
  2. Use a temperature sensor with a data logger.
ex.az: 1. 用温度感应器配数据记录器。

ex.q: A student suggests "interview every shopper" to count mall visitors.
ex.a:
1. Too slow and inaccurate for a large scope.
  2. Better: sensors at the entrances.
ex.az: 1. 规模太大，应用入口感应器。

cards.en:
Why it matters: Before cooking you wash, cut and group ingredients. Organisation is that preparation for data, so later steps are easy.

How it works:

Organisation = managing, categorising and classifying collected data to make later processing easier.

WayQuestionnaire example
Data arrangementput forms from the same class in one folder
Data validationcheck each form is filled correctly
Data type conversionenter paper data into electronic form

Exam wording:

  • Organisation means managing, categorising and classifying data to facilitate processing.
  • Three ways: arrangement, validation, type conversion.
cards.zh:
先理解: 煮饭前要洗、切、分好材料。组织数据就是这种准备，令之后的步骤更容易。

重点:

Organisation = 管理、分类数据，方便之后处理。

方法问卷例子
Data arrangement同班问卷放同一文件夹
Data validation检查问卷是否正确填写
Data type conversion把纸本资料输入电脑

考试写法:

  • managing, categorising and classifying；三种：arrangement、validation、type conversion。

ex.q: A video team saves clips into folders by week and names them "2026-11-20_clip3". Which way and why?
ex.a:
1. Data arrangement.
  2. Makes clips easy to search later.
ex.az: 1. Data arrangement，方便搜寻。

ex.q: Scanning paper forms with OMR into a spreadsheet is which way?
ex.a: 1. Paper → electronic → data type conversion.
ex.az: 1. 纸本变电子 → data type conversion。

ex.q: A student says adding subtitles to the clips is "organisation".
ex.a:
1. Wrong: subtitles edit the content → processing.
  2. They do not make searching easier.
ex.az: 1. 错：加字幕是 processing。

cards.en:
Why it matters: You keep homework in a bag to use later. Storage keeps data so it can be found and used anytime.

How it works:

After organisation, data is stored so it can be retrieved and processed anytime.

TypeGood for
Paper filessigned originals
USB flash driveportable, carry to class
Hard disklarge capacity, low cost
Cloud storageaccess anywhere, backup

Exam wording:

  • Data is stored so that it can be retrieved and processed anytime.
  • Choose by capacity, portability, access.
cards.zh:
先理解: 功课放进书包，之后才拿得出来。储存就是保留数据，随时可取用。

重点:

组织后，数据被储存，可随时取出和处理。

类型适合
纸本签署原件
USB便携
硬盘容量大、便宜
云端随处存取、备份

考试写法:

  • retrieved and processed anytime；按容量、便携、存取方式选择。

ex.q: Bring a spreadsheet to a teacher's office with no internet. Choose storage.
ex.a:
1. No internet → cloud not usable.
  2. USB flash drive: portable.
ex.az: 1. 没网络 → USB。

ex.q: Keep 2 TB of school videos for years. Choose storage.
ex.a:
1. Large capacity, low cost per GB.
  2. Hard disk (plus a backup).
ex.az: 1. 容量大 → 硬盘。

ex.q: A student says "storage means saving data in RAM".
ex.a:
1. RAM loses data when power is off.
  2. Storage for later use needs non-volatile media: hard disk, USB, cloud.
ex.az: 1. RAM 断电会失去数据，应用硬盘等。

cards.en:
Why it matters: Raw holiday footage is long and noisy. Cutting and adding music turns it into a show. That editing is processing.

How it works:

Processing means editing, modifying and updating data. Types: text, image, audio, video processing. Calculations (totals, averages) are processing too.

Video example:
  • delete unwanted scenes
  • remove noise, add background music
  • add subtitles

Exam wording:

  • Processing means editing, modifying and updating data.
cards.zh:
先理解: 原始旅行片段又长又嘈，剪辑、加音乐后变成节目。这种编辑就是 processing。

重点:

Processing = 编辑、修改和更新数据。类型：文字、图像、音频、影片处理；计算总分、平均也是处理。

  • 删除不要的片段
  • 去噪音、加背景音乐
  • 加字幕

考试写法:

  • editing, modifying and updating data

ex.q: Name the type: cropping a photo.
ex.a: 1. Changing an image → image processing.
ex.az: 1. image processing。

ex.q: A shop updates stock from 20 to 19 after a sale. Which stage?
ex.a: 1. Updating data → processing.
ex.az: 1. 更新数据 → processing。

ex.q: A student says "drawing a trend chart of sales is processing".
ex.a:
1. Looking for patterns/trends is analysis.
  2. Processing changes the data; analysis draws conclusions from it.
ex.az: 1. 找趋势是 analysis。

cards.en:
Why it matters: A doctor looks at your temperature over 5 days to see if you are getting better. Looking for meaning and trends is analysis.

How it works:

Data analysis extracts meaningful information from processed data by charts, statistics, comparison, trends.

Example: 50 years of Hong Kong annual average temperatures in a spreadsheet → see climate trends → better predictions.

Exam wording:

  • Analysis extracts meaningful information from processed data (e.g. identify trends, make predictions).
cards.zh:
先理解: 医生看你五天的体温，判断是否好转。找意义和趋势就是 analysis。

重点:

Analysis 从已处理的数据中提取有意义的资讯：图表、统计、比较、趋势。

例：50 年平均气温 → 看出气候趋势 → 作预测。

考试写法:

  • extracts meaningful information，例如 identify trends、make predictions。

ex.q: Monthly sales: Jan 120, Feb 135, Mar 150. What can analysis show?
ex.a:
1. Change per month: +15, +15.
  2. Trend: steady growth; predict April ≈ 165.
ex.az: 1. 每月 +15，预测四月约 165。

ex.q: A school compares test averages of 5 classes. Which stage and output?
ex.a:
1. Comparing → analysis.
  2. Information: which class needs more support.
ex.az: 1. 比较 → analysis。

ex.q: A student says "analysis is calculating the average".
ex.a:
1. Calculating is processing.
  2. Analysis uses the result to find meaning, e.g. "Class 5B is below average".
ex.az: 1. 计算是 processing，分析是解读结果。

cards.en:
Why it matters: Passing a note in class needs a sender, a path and a receiver who reads the same language. Data transmission is the same.

How it works:

  • Data transmission involves transmitters, media and receivers.
  • A network is one medium.
  • Both sides must use the same protocol (set of rules).
  • Example: web pages go from web servers to users using HTTP.

Exam wording:

  • Transmitters, media and receivers; both sides use the same protocol.
cards.zh:
先理解: 课堂传纸条要有传送者、路径和看得懂的接收者。数据传送也一样。

重点:

  • Transmitter、media、receiver。
  • 网络是一种媒介。
  • 双方要用相同 protocol（规则）。
  • 例：网页由 web server 用 HTTP 传给用户。

考试写法:

  • transmitters, media and receivers；same protocol。

ex.q: A phone sends a photo to a printer via Wi-Fi. Identify the three parts.
ex.a:
1. Transmitter: phone.
  2. Medium: Wi-Fi network.
  3. Receiver: printer.
ex.az: 1. 传送：手机；媒介：Wi-Fi；接收：打印机。

ex.q: Which protocol delivers web pages?
ex.a: 1. HTTP (or HTTPS for secure).
ex.az: 1. HTTP / HTTPS。

ex.q: A student says "two devices on the same network can always talk".
ex.a: 1. Not enough: they must also use the same protocol.
ex.az: 1. 还要使用相同协定。

frames.zh: 浏览器发出 HTTP 请求。

frames.en: Web server receives it and sends the page back.
Browser receives and shows the page.

cards.en:
Why it matters: All the work is useless if no one sees it. Presentation is showing the result in a form people understand.

How it works:

Presentation means the output of data or information through various media. Some devices output more than one medium.

MediaOutput device
Textprinter, monitor
Imageprinter, monitor, projector
Videomonitor, projector (+ speaker)
Audiospeaker

Exam wording:

  • Presentation is the output of data or information through various media.
cards.zh:
先理解: 做了很多工夫，没人看到就没用。展示就是用人看得懂的形式输出结果。

重点:

Presentation = 透过不同媒体输出资讯。有些装置可输出多种媒体。

媒体装置
文字打印机、显示器
图像打印机、显示器、投影机
影片显示器、投影机＋喇叭
声音喇叭

考试写法:

  • the output of data or information through various media

ex.q: Best way to present a sales trend to the board?
ex.a:
1. Trend over time → line chart.
  2. Shown on a projector in a slideshow.
ex.az: 1. 趋势 → 折线图，投影显示。

ex.q: Which device can output both images and text?
ex.a: 1. Monitor (or printer).
ex.az: 1. 显示器或打印机。

ex.q: A student says a projector can output audio.
ex.a:
1. A projector shows images/video.
  2. Audio needs a speaker.
ex.az: 1. 投影机不出声，要喇叭。

cards.en:
Why it matters: Your grandparents went to a library to find facts. You search in a second and post to the world. That change is the Information Age.

How it works:

With fast progress in ICT, microcomputers, the internet and search engines keep improving, so accessing and publishing information become easier and more popular.

  • Academic search engines find articles instantly.
  • Social media let anyone publish opinions.
  • Smartphones + mobile networks allow live streaming anywhere.
  • Films released on streaming platforms.

Exam wording:

  • In the Information Age, accessing and publishing information have become easier and more popular.
cards.zh:
先理解: 祖父母要去图书馆找资料；你一秒就搜到，还能向全世界发布。这就是资讯时代。

重点:

ICT 快速发展，电脑、互联网、搜寻器不断改进，取得和发布资讯变得更容易、更普及。

  • 学术搜寻器即时找到文章。
  • 社交媒体让人人发表意见。
  • 手机随时直播。
  • 电影在串流平台上映。

考试写法:

  • accessing and publishing information have become easier and more popular

ex.q: Give one example of "publishing information is easier".
ex.a: 1. A student posts a video review on a video platform; anyone can watch.
ex.az: 1. 学生在影片平台发布评测。

ex.q: Give one example of "accessing information is easier".
ex.a: 1. Using an academic search engine to find journal articles in seconds.
ex.az: 1. 学术搜寻器几秒找到论文。

ex.q: A student defines the Information Age as "when computers were invented".
ex.a: 1. Too narrow. It is about easy access and publishing of information due to computers, the internet and search engines.
ex.az: 1. 太窄：重点是取得和发布资讯变容易。

cards.t: Causes: personal computers and mobile devices
cards.tz: 成因：个人电脑与流动装置
cards.en:
Why it matters: Phones got cheaper, faster and easier to use, so almost everyone carries one. That spread drives the Information Age.

How it works:

CauseExam wording
Pricecomponents more affordable → devices more widespread
Performancemore computing power → data processed and transmitted anytime, anywhere
Application designinteractive design lets people access information directly (ratings, comments, subscriptions)

Exam wording:

  • Three causes: price, performance, application design.
cards.zh:
先理解: 手机变得更便宜、更快、更易用，几乎人人一部，推动资讯时代。

重点:

成因写法
Price零件更便宜 → 装置更普及
Performance运算力提升 → 随时随地处理和传送
Application design互动设计，例如评分、留言、订阅

考试写法:

  • 三个成因：price, performance, application design。

ex.q: An online shop shows star ratings. Which cause does it illustrate?
ex.a: 1. Users get information directly through interactive application design.
ex.az: 1. Application design。

ex.q: Students edit 4K video on phones. Which cause?
ex.a: 1. Higher performance (computing power).
ex.az: 1. Performance。

ex.q: A student writes "devices became more popular because of 5G".
ex.a:
1. 5G is a communication network cause, a different heading.
  2. For this heading use price/performance/app design.
ex.az: 1. 5G 属通讯网络成因。

cards.en:
Why it matters: Roads let goods travel; networks let information travel. Better roads (fibre, 5G) mean more and faster traffic.

How it works:

  • Optical fibres and better telecom technology enhance the mobility and coverage of information.
  • 5G lets devices transmit data stably and efficiently between many devices.
  • This helps IoT and video streaming.

Exam wording:

  • Optical fibres and telecom advances enhanced the mobility and coverage of information.
cards.zh:
先理解: 道路让货物流通，网络让资讯流通。光纤、5G 就像更好的路。

重点:

  • 光纤及电讯科技提升资讯的流动性和覆盖范围。
  • 5G 让多部装置稳定高效地传送数据。
  • 有利 IoT 和影片串流。

考试写法:

  • enhanced the mobility and coverage of information

ex.q: How does 5G help live streaming of a football match?
ex.a: 1. High bandwidth, stable → HD video sent smoothly from the stadium.
ex.az: 1. 频宽高、稳定 → 流畅高清直播。

ex.q: Why do optical fibres matter?
ex.a: 1. They carry large amounts of data fast over long distances → wider coverage.
ex.az: 1. 大量数据长距离快速传送。

ex.q: A student says "5G makes phones cheaper".
ex.a: 1. 5G improves data transmission, not device price.
ex.az: 1. 5G 改善传送，不是令手机便宜。

cards.en:
Why it matters: Imagine your lights, aircon and fridge chatting with your phone. Everyday objects connected and sharing data: that is IoT.

How it works:

IoT is the network of physical objects (from a phone's accelerometer to a whole observatory) where data is exchanged among devices to run applications.

Example: turn on home aircon from your phone before arriving.

Exam wording:

  • IoT is the network of physical objects; data is exchanged among devices.
cards.zh:
先理解: 想像灯、冷气、雪柜和手机互相沟通。日常物件连网、交换数据，就是 IoT。

重点:

IoT 是实体物件组成的网络，装置之间交换数据以实现各种应用。

例：回家前用手机开冷气。

考试写法:

  • network of physical objects；data is exchanged among devices。

ex.q: Describe the data flow when you switch on a smart lamp from your phone.
ex.a:
1. Phone app sends command.
  2. Command goes via internet/home router.
  3. Lamp receives and turns on, sends status back.
ex.az: 1. 手机发指令 → 经路由器 → 灯开启并回报。

ex.q: Give an IoT example in a school.
ex.a: 1. Classroom sensors measure CO₂ and switch on ventilation automatically.
ex.az: 1. 课室感应器量 CO₂，自动开通风。

ex.q: A student says "a Bluetooth speaker playing music from a phone is IoT".
ex.a:
1. Borderline: simple one-to-one streaming.
  2. A clear IoT answer shows objects exchanging data over a network to perform an application, e.g. sensors + automatic control.
ex.az: 1. 要强调物件透过网络交换数据实现应用。

frames.en: The command goes to the maker's server.
Router passes it to the aircon.
Aircon turns on and reports 24°C back to the phone.

cards.t: Development: big data and artificial intelligence
cards.tz: 发展：大数据与人工智能
cards.en:
Why it matters: Every click and card tap leaves data. Billions of them form big data. Too much for people to read, so artificial intelligence helps find patterns fast.

How it works:

  • Big data: huge amounts of data from devices and online platforms; when analysed, shows customer interests, traffic predictions, climate trends.
  • Artificial intelligence (AI): processes and analyses large amounts of data in a short time.
  • Deep learning: AI can learn by itself and improve.
  • Example: vehicle identifying technology (reading car plates).

Exam wording:

  • Big data: vast amount of data gathered → valuable information after analysis.
  • AI processes and analyses large amounts of data in a short time; with deep learning it can learn by itself.
cards.zh:
先理解: 每次点击、拍卡都留下数据，数以亿计就成为 big data。人看不完，artificial intelligence 帮忙快速找规律。

重点:

  • Big data：大量数据，分析后看出顾客兴趣、交通预测、气候趋势。
  • AI：短时间处理和分析大量数据。
  • Deep learning：可自我学习。
  • 例：车牌辨识。

考试写法:

  • vast amount of data；AI in a short time；learn by itself。

ex.q: How can a supermarket use big data?
ex.a:
1. Analyse millions of purchases.
  2. Find what customers buy together → plan promotions.
ex.az: 1. 分析购买纪录，安排推广。

ex.q: How does AI help a car park?
ex.a:
1. Camera reads plates with vehicle identification.
  2. Gate opens automatically and fee is charged.
ex.az: 1. 车牌辨识，自动开闸收费。

ex.q: A student writes "big data means a very large file".
ex.a: 1. Wrong: big data is a vast amount of data collected from many sources for analysis, not one file.
ex.az: 1. 错：是从多来源收集的大量数据。

cards.en:
Why it matters: Information is easy to get, but not all of it is true or free to use. Information literacy is knowing how to use information wisely and fairly.

How it works:

AspectKey idea
Intellectual propertyintangible creation of a person; using it without permission is unethical and illegal
Data privacydo not share others' private info without permission
Credibilitycheck authoritativeness, validity, relevance; search more to confirm
Extraction and organisationsearch various media, extract, organise, form your own opinion

Exam wording:

  • Four aspects: intellectual property, data privacy, credibility, extraction and organisation.
cards.zh:
先理解: 资讯容易取得，但不一定真确，也不一定可以随便用。资讯素养就是聪明而公平地使用资讯。

重点:

方面重点
Intellectual property未经许可使用他人创作，不道德且违法
Data privacy未经同意不分享他人私隐
Credibility检查权威性、有效性、相关性
Extraction and organisation多渠道搜寻、整理，形成自己观点

考试写法:

  • 四方面：intellectual property, data privacy, credibility, extraction and organisation。

ex.q: Tom Ho sees a post "Drinking hot water cures flu". What should he do?
ex.a:
1. Check credibility: who wrote it? Is it a medical authority?
  2. Search other reliable sources (e.g. Department of Health).
ex.az: 1. 检查可信度，搜寻权威来源。

ex.q: Amy posts a classmate's phone number in a group chat. Which aspect?
ex.a: 1. Data privacy: shared without permission.
ex.az: 1. Data privacy。

ex.q: A student says "if a picture is online, I can use it freely".
ex.a:
1. Wrong: online images are still intellectual property.
  2. Need permission or a licence (e.g. Creative Commons) and credit the author.
ex.az: 1. 错：网上图片仍是知识产权，要获许可。

mc.e: Computer engineers design, build and integrate hardware, software and network.

mc.ez: 影片是图像和音频的组合。

sq.q: ABC Secondary School is promoting e-learning and has bought enough computers for a whole class.

parts.q: Suggest an input device the school should purchase.
parts.ms: Keyboard / mouse / microphone / webcam (any one)

parts.q: Suggest an output device the school should purchase.
parts.ms: Monitor / speaker / headphones / printer (any one)

parts.q: Give an example of application software to install.
parts.ms: Word processor / web browser / presentation software (any one)

sq.q: A school is organising a singing contest. You are in charge of hardware and personnel.

parts.q: What input and output devices will the participants need?
parts.ms:
Input: microphone (1)
Output: speaker (1)

parts.q: State the purposes of the devices in (a).
parts.ms:
Microphone converts the singer's voice into electrical signals for the system (1)
Speaker plays the amplified sound to the audience (1)

parts.q: The school database records all participants and helpers. What is a database administrator responsible for?
parts.ms: Designing and managing the database (1)

sq.q: An advertising agency creates ads in image or video formats.

parts.q: State an advantage of vector images over bitmap images.
parts.ms: Will not become blurry / no rough edges when scaled up or down (1). (Not "smaller file size": the book lists smaller file size as an advantage of bitmap images.)

parts.q: A client wants a TV advertisement. What device is needed to shoot the video?
parts.ms: Digital (video) camera (1)

sq.q: Tom Ho wants to collect public opinion on e-learning for his project.

parts.q: What method can he use to collect data?
parts.ms: Survey / questionnaire / interview (1)

parts.q: He stores the data in a spreadsheet. What storage device can he use to bring the file to the teacher?
parts.ms: USB flash drive / portable hard disk (1)

sq.q: Susan writes a project on global warming and finds an online article claiming a newly evolved 'flying penguin'.

parts.q: Should Susan use the article as a reference? Why?
parts.ms:
No (1)
The information is not credible / not from an authoritative source / should be verified with other sources (1)

parts.q: She finds an article that covers everything. Can she submit the whole article as her project? Explain.
parts.ms:
No (1)
It infringes the author's intellectual property / is plagiarism; she should extract, organise and cite information and write her own ideas (1)

sq.q: A clinic introduces an information system to handle patient records, prescriptions and payments.

parts.q: State TWO purposes of implementing the system.
parts.ms:
Automate processes (1)
Reduce human errors / improve efficiency (1)

parts.q: Name the five components of an information system and give one clinic example of each.
parts.ms:
Data: patient medical history (1)
Hardware: computer / barcode scanner (1)
Software: DBMS / OS (1)
Process: doctor writes prescription → pharmacist dispenses → receipt (1)
Personnel: database administrator / nurse (1)

parts.q: Explain why the order of the process matters.
parts.ms: Later steps depend on data from earlier steps (1), e.g. medicine can only be dispensed after the prescription is recorded (1)

sq.q: A PE teacher records the weights (kg) of 200 primary students and produces a histogram.

parts.q: Explain the difference between data and information using this example.
parts.ms:
Data: the list of individual weights, unorganised with no meaning on its own (1)
Information: the histogram / most common weight range, data put into context to support decisions (1)

parts.q: Describe the IPO cycle for producing the histogram.
parts.ms:
Input: weights entered via keyboard (1)
Process: group weights into ranges and count students in each (1)
Output: histogram displayed/printed (1)

sq.q: A designer prepares materials for a school open day: a photo of the campus, a school logo for a large banner, a recorded welcome speech and a promotional video.

parts.q: Should the logo be bitmap or vector? Explain.
parts.ms: Vector (1); it will not become blurry/jagged when scaled up to banner size (1)

parts.q: Describe how the welcome speech becomes a digital audio file.
parts.ms: Microphone converts sound into an analog electrical signal (1); sound card converts it into binary (digital) data for storage (1)

parts.q: Why is the video stored as a compressed file?
parts.ms: Videos (many images + audio) have large file sizes; compression reduces size for storage/transmission (1)

parts.q: The welcome text is saved as .txt and as .docx. Which is larger? Why?
parts.ms: .docx (1); formatted text stores formatting data such as font type, size and colour in addition to characters (1)

sq.q: The student union of ABC Secondary School runs a paper survey on canteen food and presents results at assembly.

parts.q: Give one example of each of data arrangement, data validation and data type conversion in this survey.
parts.ms:
Arrangement: sort forms by class into folders (1)
Validation: check each form is completed correctly (1)
Conversion: enter paper responses into a spreadsheet (1)

parts.q: Distinguish between processing and analysis in this survey.
parts.ms:
Processing: editing/updating data, e.g. calculating totals of each rating (1)
Analysis: extracting meaningful information, e.g. identifying which food is least popular and why (1)

parts.q: Suggest suitable output devices for presentation at assembly.
parts.ms: Projector (1); speaker (1)

sq.q: A city installs smart lamp posts with sensors connected via 5G.

parts.q: Explain why this is an example of the Internet of Things.
parts.ms: Physical objects (lamp posts/sensors) are networked (1) and exchange data to implement applications such as traffic monitoring (1)

parts.q: Explain how big data and artificial intelligence can help traffic planning.
parts.ms:
Large amount of traffic data is collected from many sensors (big data) (1)
AI processes and analyses it in a short time (1)
to predict traffic situations / adjust signals (1)

parts.q: State TWO causes of the Information Age related to personal computers and mobile devices.
parts.ms:
Lower price of components so devices widespread (1)
Higher computing power of mobile devices / interactive application design (1)
